title: Evidence-Pack Store Access Log (tamper-evident hash chain)
description: Schema for the access log of the EVIDENCE PACK STORE itself (SPEC §7 item 7): a tamper-evident, append-only record of who read/listed/exported the evidence container. Each entry carries the hash of the previous entry (prev_hash) forming a hash chain, plus the entry's own canonical hash (entry_hash). The live source of these entries is Azure Storage diagnostic logging delivered to an immutable (WORM) append-only container; this schema validates an exported representation of that log (evidence/access-log.jsonl, parsed to a list, or a wrapper object with an 'entries' array). Presence + verifiable chain are BOTH required for a PASS by check_access_log.py; because the LIVE diagnostic log is an Azure runtime concern that does not exist offline, the validator HONESTLY emits INDETERMINATE when no exported log is present — never a fabricated PASS. Tier is EVIDENCE-ONLY.

container.description: The evidence-pack storage container whose access is being logged (e.g. the Azure Blob container holding sealed evidence packs).

hash_algorithm.description: Algorithm used for prev_hash / entry_hash. Only sha256 is supported by the verifier.

source.description: Provenance of the log (informational): Azure diagnostic settings + immutable container target.

entries.description: Ordered, append-only list of access events. May be empty in a freshly-provisioned log (the validator treats an empty live log as INDETERMINATE, not PASS, since it proves nothing about real access capture).

seq.description: Monotonic 0-based sequence number; entry N's prev_hash must equal entry N-1's entry_hash.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the access event.

operation.description: The access operation captured against the evidence container.

principal.description: Identity (object id / UPN / managed identity) that performed the operation.

object_path.description: Blob/path acted upon within the container.

prev_hash.description: Hex sha256 of the previous entry's entry_hash chain input. The genesis entry (seq 0) uses the all-zero hash (64 zero hex chars).

entry_hash.description: Hex sha256 over the canonical JSON of the entry payload (all fields except entry_hash) including prev_hash. Recomputed and verified by check_access_log.py.
